steps.title: Prepare E8 Flex medium
steps.instruction: Thaw the Essential 8™ Flex supplement at room temperature (~1 h) or 2–8 °C overnight, protect from light, invert gently, then add the entire 10 mL supplement to 500 mL Essential 8™ Flex basal medium, swirl to mix. Store at 2–8 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Make Geltrex coating solution
steps.instruction: Keep all components at 2–8 °C. Mix 24.75 mL cold DMEM/F‑12 with 250 µL Geltrex (from –20 °C) in a 50 mL conical tube, pipette up/down to dissolve, bring total volume to 25 mL. Store at 2–8 °C for 1 week.

steps.title: Prepare Collagenase IV solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g collagenase type IV powder in 100 mL DMEM/F‑12, filter‑sterilize, aliquot 10 mL as 10× stock (10 mg/mL). For 1× working solution, dilute 10 mL stock with 90 mL DMEM/F‑12, filter‑sterilize, aliquot 12.5 mL. Store both at –20 °C (≤6 months). Bring 1× solution to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Prepare Neural Induction Medium (NIM)
steps.instruction: For each day, mix 500 mL E8 Flex medium with 5 mL Pen/Strep (1 %). Add SB431542 to a final 10 µM and LDN193189 to 0.1 µM fresh on the day of use. Filter‑sterilize, bring to room temperature, and keep protected from light.

steps.title: Prepare Neural Maturation Medium (NMM)
steps.instruction: Make a bulk >200 mL of basic medium: 95 mL DMEM/F‑12, 95 mL Neurobasal, 2 mL Pen/Strep (1 %), 4 mL B‑27 minus vitamin A (2 %), 2 mL N‑2 (1 %), 2 mL L‑Glutamine (1 %). Store at 2–8 °C (≤4 weeks). For daily use, aliquot required volume, add SB431542 10 µM, LDN193189 0.1 µM, FGF 10 ng/mL, EGF 10 ng/mL fresh, filter, warm to 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Astrocyte Differentiation Medium (ADM)
steps.instruction: Make bulk >200 mL basic medium: 194 mL Neurobasal, 2 mL Pen/Strep (1 %), 2 mL N‑2 (1 %), 2 mL NEAA (1 %), 800 µL L‑Ascorbic acid (200 µM final, 0.8 µM). Add fresh FGF 10 ng/mL, IGF‑1 200 ng/mL, Activin A 10 ng/mL, Heregulin β‑1 10 ng/mL, filter, warm to 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Astrocyte Maturation Medium (AMM)
steps.instruction: Make bulk 500 mL basic medium: 231.5 mL DMEM/F‑12, 231.5 mL Neurobasal, 5 mL Pen/Strep (1 %), 5 mL N‑2 (1 %), 5 mL NEAA (1 %), 2 mL L‑Ascorbic acid (200 µM, 0.8 µM), 5 mL L‑Glutamine (1 %), 5 mL Sodium pyruvate (1 %), 10 mL FBS (2 %). Add fresh IGF‑1 200 ng/mL, Activin A 10 ng/mL, Heregulin β‑1 10 ng/mL, filter, warm to 37 °C.

steps.title: Plate hiPSCs for neural induction
steps.instruction: Coat a 6‑well plate with 1 mL/well Geltrex (see step 2) for at least 30 min at 37 °C, then add 2 mL/well E8 Flex medium. Seed hiPSCs and expand to 70–90 % confluence (day 0). Use one full 6‑well plate per line.

steps.title: Dissociate hiPSCs and start induction
steps.instruction: At day 0, aspirate spent E8 Flex, wash 1 mL/well DPBS, add 1 mL/well room‑temperature Collagenase IV 1×, incubate 10–20 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (check every 5 min after 10 min; max 60 min). Add 1 mL/well room‑temperature E8 Flex, gently scrape, transfer suspension to one 15 mL conical tube per plate, incubate 15 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to let clusters settle. Remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 10 mL room‑temperature NIM, transfer to a T25 non‑adherent flask (mark passage 0). Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: NIM medium changes (days 1, 2, 4)
steps.instruction: Place the T25 flask upright in a sterile 25 or 50 mL reservoir inside the incubator, let cells sediment 5–10 min. Transfer flask to biosafety cabinet, remove ~9 mL spent medium, add 10 mL fresh room‑temperature NIM. Repeat on days 1, 2, 4.

steps.title: Plate embryoid bodies for neural rosettes (day 7)
steps.instruction: Coat a new 6‑well plate with Geltrex (step 2) and incubate ≥30 min at 37 °C. Add 1 mL/well NMM, incubate 37 °C. Collect EBs from the T25 flask into 15 mL tubes, let settle 5–10 min at 37 °C, aspirate spent medium, add 1 mL/well 37 °C NMM (no pipetting). Transfer 1 mL EB suspension to each well (total 2 mL NMM per well). Incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Change NMM daily until day 10.

steps.title: Passage neural rosettes (day 10, P1)
steps.instruction: Coat a 6‑well plate with Geltrex (30 min, 37 °C). Add 1 mL/well NMM + 5 µL/mL RevitaCell, incubate 37 °C. Add 1 mL/well room‑temperature Accutase, incubate 4 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Add 1 mL/well 37 °C NMM to inactivate. Scrape cells, transfer to 15 mL tube, centrifuge 145 × g for 4 min at room temperature (ensure volume >3 mL). Remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL/well 37 °C NMM + 5 µL/mL RevitaCell. Plate 1 mL onto each Geltrex‑coated well containing 1 mL NMM + RevitaCell (total 2 mL). Rock plate gently, incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Change medium day 11 with 2–6 mL 37 °C NMM, then every second day until day 16.

steps.title: Expand and optionally cryopreserve NPCs (days 12‑14, P2)
steps.instruction:
Coat 6‑well plates with Geltrex (30 min, 37 °C). Add 1 mL/well NMM + 5 µL/mL RevitaCell, incubate. Wash cells with DPBS, add 1 mL/well room‑temperature Accutase, incubate 4 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ (extend 1 min if needed). Add 1 mL/well 37 °C NMM to inactivate, flush cells, collect to 15 mL tube, centrifuge 145 × g 4 min RT. Remove supernatant.
• For passaging: resuspend pellet in 1 mL/well NMM + 5 µL/mL RevitaCell, plate 1 mL onto each Geltrex‑coated well with 1 mL NMM + RevitaCell (2 mL total). Rock, incubate 37 °C. Change next day with 2 mL 37 °C NMM, then every second day until day 16.
• For cryopreservation: resuspend pellet in 1 mL room‑temperature freezing medium (90 % FBS, 10 % DMSO), aliquot 1 mL per pre‑labeled cryovial, place vials in a Mr. Frosty with isopropanol, store –80 °C overnight, then transfer to liquid N₂ for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Thaw cryopreserved NPCs (if needed)
steps.instruction: Coat 6‑well plates with Geltrex (30 min, 37 °C). Prepare 15 mL tubes with 9 mL 37 °C basic NMM (no growth factors). Thaw a cryovial 1 min in a 37 °C water bath until a pea‑sized ice chunk remains. Add ~0.5 mL basic NMM, pipette to dissolve, transfer to tube; repeat until the entire content is transferred. Centrifuge 145 × g 4 min RT. Remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL/well 37 °C NMM + 5 µL/mL RevitaCell, plate 1 mL onto each Geltrex‑coated well with 1 mL NMM + RevitaCell (2 mL total). Incubate 37 °C. Change next day with 2 mL 37 °C NMM (with growth factors), then every second day until day 16.

steps.title: Differentiate NPCs to astrocyte progenitors (day 16‑25)
steps.instruction: On day 16, replace medium with 2 mL/well 37 °C ADM (see step 6). Change ADM every second day (e.g., 4–6 mL/well on Fridays to avoid weekend work) until day 25. Do not passage cells during this period; expect some cell death and vacuolization.

steps.title: Mature astrocytes (day 25 onward)
steps.instruction:
On day 25 (d+0) you may either (a) cryopreserve astrocytes (see step 15) or (b) continue maturation.
For continuation: optionally passage cells 1:6 for expansion. Coat new 6‑well plates with Geltrex (30 min, 37 °C). Add half the well volume of AMM + 5 µL/mL RevitaCell, incubate. Remove spent ADM/AMM, wash with DPBS, add room‑temperature Accutase (volume per Table 1), incubate 4 min at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂. Add equal volume 37 °C AMM to inactivate, collect cells, centrifuge 145 × g 4 min RT.
• For passaging: resuspend pellet in remaining half AMM + RevitaCell, plate onto Geltrex‑coated wells with equal volume AMM + RevitaCell (total 2 mL per well). Rock, incubate 37 °C, change medium next day and every second day (4–6 mL/well on Mon/Wed/Fri).
• For cryopreservation: resuspend pellet in 1 mL room‑temperature freezing medium (90 % FBS, 10 % DMSO), aliquot 1 mL per cryovial, freeze as in step 12.

steps.title: Thaw cryopreserved astrocytes
steps.instruction: Coat 6‑well plates with Geltrex (30 min, 37 °C). Prepare 15 mL tubes with 9 mL 37 °C basic AMM (no growth factors). Thaw a cryovial 1 min in a 37 °C water bath, add ~0.5 mL basic AMM, pipette, transfer to tube; repeat to collect all cells. Centrifuge 145 × g 4 min RT. Remove supernatant, resuspend pellet in 1 mL/well 37 °C AMM + 5 µL/mL RevitaCell, plate 1 mL onto each Geltrex‑coated well with 1 mL AMM + RevitaCell (2 mL total). Rock, incubate 37 °C. Change next day with 2 mL 37 °C AMM (with growth factors), then every second day.
